## Summary

Describe the problem or proposed improvement clearly.

## Reproduction or use case

List the smallest reproducible steps, or explain the concrete user need.

## Expected behaviour

Describe the expected result.

## Environment

Include the Shortlinker version and relevant browser, WordPress, proxy, or
deployment details. Never include passwords, API tokens, raw visitor data, or
private URLs.

## Verification

Explain how the change or fix could be verified.
